summary: Independently reviewed N3's React changes. Focused Node and Go emitter suites pass and source behavior matches the lowerCamel Action, Go Message, slice target and physical unmount requirements. A Proxy get trap bypasses the own target descriptor check, so strict slice admission needs one amendment before acceptance.

confirmed: Renderer callbacks use lowerCamel {path,event,value} Action and uppercase {Name,Arg} Go Message.
GoScript slice wrappers require exactly backing/capacity/length/offset/target own keys, with enumerable own data descriptors and target undefined.
Post-unmount domSnapshot checks the physical container childNodes are empty before returning empty HTML and controls; viewRecord returns null.
Emitter metadata correction is confined to emit/backend_test.go; focused test fixture now describes the actual seven-field gobi.Node and nested metadata.

finding.summary: listOrEmpty validates property descriptors but then reads GoScript slice fields with ordinary gets. A Proxy can return target:undefined while its own target data descriptor contains {}.
finding.required_repair: Validate from descriptor.value snapshots; copy dense native-array elements and GoScript backing arrays before later indexing/slicing; avoid ordinary property access and backing.slice gets on caller-owned values.

limits: N3's focused Node tests exercise lowerView without mounting a browser DOM.
N6 still owns mounted-browser physical unmount and fresh generated-app integration checks.
This independent React review does not accept or assess N4 runtime correctness.
